propositions: Routine MCP backoffs (port-exhausted retire-cap and low-memory abort) incorrectly emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR/deploy_failed, inflating deploy_errors metric and falsely paging the rebar-autodeploy-errors alarm during normal graceful drains.

The observability.sh contract documents that retire-cap and mem-abort markers must be kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR to distinguish routine backoffs from genuine failures; the autodeploy.sh implementation violates this contract by calling record_mcp_backoff_failure on both routine paths.
Genuine MCP deployment failures (build/tag/run/unhealthy/handshake/flip) must continue to emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR and page deploy_errors without regression.

The MCP backoff throttle (backoff file writes and pruning) must remain active on routine paths to prevent tick hammering during extended graceful drains, while only the erroneous deploy_errors emission is removed.
This is a documented plan defect introduced in commit 2a0a4b19f2ab (ticket 6964) where the contract and implementation were added simultaneously but inconsistently.
